input.selection: lexicographically sorted first N native ARWs

pre_registration.alignment_red: At N=33, compare alignment off and on independently; the aligned pre arm must contain at least two worker hashes because it is the registered M139 configuration.
pre_registration.frame_count_red: At fixed W1/W16 and alignment off, N=17 or N=33 must differ to show that raising N activates a nontrivial chunk grouping.
pre_registration.original_gate: N=16, alignment off, pre W1 pixel hash must differ from pre W16
pre_registration.prequantization_follow_up: Hash f32 plane bits immediately after BandMerge::finish and before u16 encoding. Probe on/off must leave the TIFF hash unchanged.
pre_registration.repair_green: The post-D9 N=33 aligned arm must have one pixel hash and one TIFF hash across W1/W2/W4/W8/W16.
pre_registration.structural_null_prediction: At N=16/W16, ceil(N/workers)=1. Absorbing one-frame partials left-to-right is predicted to reproduce W1's frame order, so this specific pair may be incapable of exposing regrouping.
pre_registration.worker_spread_red: At N=16 alignment off, at least one of W2/W4/W8 must differ from another worker count for the output gate to have power without changing the stimulus.

protocol.question: Can the exact pre-D9 binary produce distinct output hashes under an admissible worker-count configuration?
